feeds.title: Soca News
feeds.description: Soca News is a Caribbean-focused brand dedicated to music, news, culture, carnivals and lifestyle. We have been established for over 20 years and have built up a loyal following of readers who appreciate Soca News's distinctive content, which informs, entertains and inspires.

feeds.title: 13th Street Promotions » Soca Music
feeds.description: Wade Haye, founder of 13th Street Promotions is a lover of music, art, fashion, trying to get out of the bucket and bring along some peeps for the ride! Check out his articles on Soca music, artists, news and more!

feeds.title: Sokah2Soca
feeds.description: More than just a music blog, Sokah2Soca offers many things to various segments of the Caribbean region. This blog features the Caribbean diaspora's people, music, and carnival culture. It aims to connect the Caribbean diaspora from across the world who celebrate the Soca carnival culture vibrantly.

feeds.title: Soca Music Tv
feeds.description: Soca music (also known as the soul of Calypso) is a genre of Caribbean music that originated within a marginalized subculture in Trinidad and Tobago in the late 1970s, and developed into a range of styles in the 1980s and later. Join us as we promote only hot new and classic Soca content to the world!

feeds.title: Kribbean » Soca
feeds.description: KRIBBEAN main purpose is to conquer the digital to better promote the Caribbean culture and to contribute to its international radiance. Today we help Caribbean event organizers as well as local and international artists like Ce'Cile, Popcaan, Nikki Brooks, Onirose and others to boost and qualify their online communication and better manage their social networks. Know more about Soca music industry, artists, community, events and more!

feeds.title: Wukkout Blog » Soca Music
feeds.description: Wukkout! is a high-energy, inclusive and dynamic Caribbean Carnival-like dance fitness experience designed to get you out of your head and into your body so you can feel free, get healthy, and have SO much fun doing it. Explore our Soca music playlists, curated perfectly for your fitness regime.

feeds.title: LargeUp » Soca
feeds.description: LargeUp is a global platform for Caribbean music, arts and culture. Based in New York, Kingston, Jamaica, and Miami, the Large Up team captures the unique sounds, styles, flavors, destinations and activities that define Island culture in the Caribbean and abroad. Find new musics, DJ mixes and more in Soca Music.

feeds.title: Tropicalfete » Soca
feeds.description: Established in 1999 as an online publication & cultural resource center. In 2011 Tropicalfete became a Not for Profit corporation and aims to develop the community in the area of arts and social services with the focus on educating the community on Caribbean culture. Check out the latest happenings in Soca music industry, artists, events and more!

feeds.title: Sokah2Soca
feeds.description: Sokah2Soca is not just a music blog, it is many things to various segments of the Caribbean region. This blog features the people, music, and carnival culture of the Caribbean diaspora. Our people are dispersed throughout the World, and we celebrate our carnival culture in a vibrant manner just like we do under the Caribbean sun.

feeds.title: Sokah2Soca
feeds.description: We are about Soca Music, Caribbean Culture and the Vibe of the Caribbean Basin. My name is Ananda aka Santiwah to my friends, I am the site administrator for Sokah2Soca. The blog curates and disseminates Calypso information and then Soca music information
